relations.subject: Daniel Henry Holmes Ingalls Sr.
relations.evidence: Daniel Henry Holmes Ingalls Sr. (May 4, 1916 – July 17, 1999) was the Wales Professor of Sanskrit at Harvard University.

relations.subject: Daniel Henry Holmes Ingalls Sr.
relations.evidence: He received his A.B. in 1936 at Harvard University, as a major in Greek and Latin.

relations.subject: Daniel Henry Holmes Ingalls Sr.
